scene: The brass weather vane carries a tiny mechanical copper finch on top.
picture: First-person close-up view of the gleaming brass weather vane against bright blue sky. A tiny intricate copper mechanical finch perches atop the central directional arrow. A tiny winding key protrudes from the bird's side up high, and a miniature brass scroll tube is clamped tight to the arrow shaft in the centre.
shown: A small winding key sticking out of the copper finch up high
A tiny brass message cylinder clamped to the arrow shaft centre
